$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$paths=@(
 (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'agent-control-panel\tools\agent-control\agentctl.mjs'),
 (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods\tools\agent-control\agentctl.mjs')
)
$ctl=$paths | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
if(-not $ctl){ throw 'agentctl.mjs not found on heaven2' }
Write-Output "AGENTCTL=$ctl"
node $ctl status
node $ctl snapshot
node $ctl workers
node $ctl leases
node $ctl queue
node $ctl branches
node $ctl routing
